description: REMI - Points d'arrêts routiers is a dataset listed in data.centrevaldeloire.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Centre-Val de Loire. Ce jeu de données concerne l'ensemble des points d'arrêt physiques routiers desservis par le réseau de transport routier régional (réseau scolaire et commercial). Il remplace celui précédemment publié qui n'était plus maintenu. Coverage: Centre-Val de Loire. The portal files it under Mobilité, geospatial. Its keywords are mobilité, REMI, transport, ramassage scolaire, interurbain, lignes régulières. The portal shows 28,337 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-centrevaldeloire-fr-portal.
